title: OceanRemover
description: Removes oceans from Minecraft generation by forcing the continentalness between 0.2 and 1.
body:
# Removes Ocean's from both biomes and world generation.
A simple datapack that removes ocean's from the terrain generation. 
## Usage
if you plan to put it in a modpack paxi is a good way to force the datapack to be used, however if not go into your world generation screen > more > Data packs > open pack folder and cut/copy the datapack in there.
